evidence.explanation: The renamed JS initialization/pass calls and per-pass temporary storage preserve the tested unjoined mkmap pipeline composition. This qualifies eleven call/buffer-delegation keys in the finite successful-allocation domain, not independent RNG or all cave generation.
evidence.proof: Twenty-four smoothed targets and24 unsmoothed controls: four seeds3/19/43/101 ×three foreground/background pairsROOM/STONE,CORR/TREE,ICE/WATER ×lit0/1. Supported public JS des.level_init(mines) executes the whole production pipeline. Its observed legal rn2/rnd tape drives exact compiled C mkmap,init_map,init_fill,get_map,all three passes andfinish_map. Every one of1,680 cells matches on typ,lit,roomno andicedpool, and C consumes the entire tape with exact operation/bound checks. All24 paired controls have identical tapes but different output hashes.
evidence.control: Unsmoothed controls skip pass_three while retaining the same initialization draws. Target smoothing executes its two source iterations. Joining and wallification are disabled; their C hooks abort if reached, so cave-cap is neither exercised nor resolved. Explicit lit0/1 only; negative-light/depth RNG, joined/walled maps, independent generator equivalence, allocator failures, reused map metadata, room topology, finalization and runtime are outside scope. Existing individual-pass and finish metadata proofs are dependencies, not recounted discoveries.
